events.label: Наука
entries: 1909 – Burgess Shale fossils are discovered by Charles Doolittle Walcott.
1983 – STS-8: The Space Shuttle Challenger takes off on the first night launch of the shuttle program. Guion Bluford becomes the first African-American in space on this mission.
1984 – STS-41-D: The Space Shuttle Discovery takes off on its maiden voyage.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1835 – Australia: Melbourne, Victoria is founded.
1836 – The city of Houston is founded by Augustus Chapman Allen and John Kirby Allen.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1535 – With the papal bull Eius qui immobilis, Pope Paul III excommunicates King Henry VIII of England from the Catholic Church for approving the Acts of Supremacy, although the bull is likely never published.
